text:
maya: Quick sync — week-of-launch looks tight. ACME SSO pilot + embeddings cache perf regression are putting pressure on the milestone. We need to decide cuts or a short reset.
raj: Agree. What's the absolute minimal path for an MVP that customers can pilot?
maya: Minimal MVP = hosted inference API, basic auth, model catalog, observability. Defer tenant-routing, on-prem packaging, advanced quotas. ACME specifically wants SSO + audit logs for pilot.
sam: Can we enable SSO just for ACME behind a feature flag to avoid a full tenancy lift? That would limit infra churn.
lin: Technically yes — SSO + audit-log webhook is mostly integration and a couple small schema fields. Tenant routing requires infra changes and rollout testing.
carol: Embeddings cache regression showed ~15–20% token cost increase in our perf harness. Ops says a fix is doable but unknown ETA. If we ship caching now we risk customer cost shock.
maya: Proposal: Ship MVP with SSO pilot enabled by request (canary flag for ACME), keep caching disabled by default, and push tenant-routing + on-prem to v1. That preserves the pilot while limiting scope.
raj: Sounds pragmatic. We should lock launch criteria: 1) basic SLA doc 2) billing verification 3) rollback path 4) security sign-off for SSO pilot.
sam: SLA targets: 99.9% availability for hosted routes, p95 < 300ms for common gen endpoints. Billing: verify per-token measurement on prod-like load. Rollback: fallback to smaller model and circuit-breaker. Example fallback config: ```fallback_model: "redwood-small" threshold_p95: 500ms```
lin: Action: Eng to produce a 1-pager cutlist + risk matrix with rough estimates by EOD tomorrow. Include risk if embeddings fix slips.
maya: Action: @raj to draft ACME pilot enablement + comms (how-to, contract appendix, support runbook).
carol: Ops will prioritize embeddings regression triage — ETA next Tue. If not resolved, caching remains off and we ship without it.
raj: Decision rule: If embeddings fix not in staging by Tue EOD, we take a 2-week milestone reset window; otherwise we keep current date.
maya: Final decision recorded here: - MVP scoped: hosted inference, basic auth, model catalog, SSO pilot by flag for ACME, observability, no tenant-routing, caching disabled by default. - v1: tenant-routing, on-prem deploy package, caching opt-in after perf patch. I'll update the roadmap and ping execs.
sam: :thumbsup:
eng-bot: Deploy checklist ticket created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/mvp-launch-1758888000 — assigned to eng oncall.
maya: Thanks all. Reconvene Mon 10am for status unless embeddings triage changes the plan.
